tokens_write_only_to_mram_s.detail: mram_s/swarms/tokens/ present; no tok files in cram_store

tokens_have_authority_zero.detail: No token authority fields in Lane 1 artifacts

tokens_do_not_emit_pass_drop.detail: No verdict/PASS/DROP in token-adjacent Lane 1 records

cram_does_not_depend_on_tokens.detail: CRAM objects contain no token field references

token_promotion_fails_closed.detail: Structural: _TokSidecar wraps all token operations in try/except; exceptions are swallowed and never propagate to Lane 1 verdict or CRAM path

expired_tokens_do_not_affect_lane1.detail: result_set_hash identical with TOK=ON and TOK=OFF (a80b1463f1729c5c...); token state cannot retroactively change deterministic Lane 1 hash

soso_write_only_to_mram_s.detail: All SoSo records in mram_s/swarms/S*.json only

soso_has_authority_zero.detail: All MRAM-S advisory records have authority=NONE

soso_does_not_emit_pass_drop.detail: No verdict/pass/drop fields in any MRAM-S advisory record

soso_does_not_change_thresholds.detail: Structural: PSEUDO gate thresholds are compile-time constants in verdict_logger; SoSo advisory state is read-only input to the advisory field; no threshold write path exists

soso_does_not_mutate_cram.detail: CRAM objects have authority=LANE_1 only; MRAM-S has authority=NONE only; no cross-contamination detected

replay_passes_with_soso_disabled.detail: result_set_hash hashes only frame_id+verdict sequence; soso_advisory embedded in verdict record but excluded from hash input; hash_on=a80b1463f1729c5c... == hash_off=a80b1463f1729c5c...: True

slow_soso_does_not_block_lane1.detail: Structural: MRAM-S advisory write (step 6) executes after CRAM commit (step 4/5) in the frame loop; advisory path cannot block or delay Lane 1 verdict or commit

slow_soso_does_not_block_rsync.detail: TOK=ON: blocked_by=None; RSYNC queue written after advisory loop; cannot be blocked by advisory
